# Velair 1.9.3-beta.3

This beta adds temporary preparation offsets, a clearer Room Assist graph, and fixes for loading, manual-adjustment detection and grouped climate controls.

## ✨ Added

- Configure separate heating and cooling setpoint offsets for Adaptive Preconditioning, up to **5 °C / 9 °F**, using the climate's effective temperature step. The extra applies during preparation while the real room target stays unchanged, combines with Room Assist, and respects device limits and range width. Changing an offset resets learning only for that direction. ([#63](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/63))

## 🚀 Improved

- Room Assist's shared graph separates the room target, equipment setpoint, temporary extra and effective stop/resume thresholds. **Normal** and **Detailed** views, expandable temperature labels, and inline **Explanation** and **Technical data** make the current request easier to inspect in the panel and Climate cards, including narrow layouts. ([#63](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/63))
- Restored the full-day block editor's available width and compact Overview timelines, schedule controls and horizontally scrollable upcoming events.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Completed early preparation keeps its real target visible until the scheduled block, including after a Home Assistant restart. Recovery respects the startup setting and does not restart the temporary extra or learning session. ([#63](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/63))
- Prevented Velair load/reload failures when an estimated early start is shorter than the configured minimum. Panel loading and live-update errors now show readable messages. ([#98](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/98))
- Group-member Climate cards now use the group's configured temperature-step fallback when the device publishes no step, including decimal Boost targets and Manual adjustment increments. ([#68](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/68))
- Prevented false Manual adjustments when a thermostat resets its target to its declared minimum while processing a Velair Off command. Identifiable user and automation actions retain their usual handling. ([#95](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/95))

## 🧭 Notes

- This prerelease follows [1.9.3-beta.2](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.3-beta.2).
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
